import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { SalesService } from 'src/app/services/sales.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-payment', templateUrl: './payment.component.html', styleUrls: ['./payment.component.css'], }) export class PaymentComponent implements OnInit { orderData: any = { items: [] }; totalAmount: number = 0; isLoading: boolean = false; paymentSuccess: boolean = false; orderId: string = ''; // Payment method selectedPaymentMethod: string = 'cod'; // Shipping address shippingAddress: string = ''; constructor( private router: Router, private salesService: SalesService, ) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.loadCartData(); } loadCartData(): void { const savedCart = localStorage.getItem('checkout_cart'); if (savedCart) { this.orderData = JSON.parse(savedCart); if (this.orderData.items && this.orderData.items.length > 0) { this.totalAmount = this.orderData.items.reduce( (sum: number, item: any) => { const price = Number(item.price) || 0; const qty = Number(item.quantity) || 1; return sum + price * qty; }, 0, ); } } // Load saved address const savedAddress = localStorage.getItem('shippingAddress'); if (savedAddress) { this.shippingAddress = savedAddress; } } selectPaymentMethod(method: string): void { this.selectedPaymentMethod = method; } placeOrder(): void { // Validate shipping address if (!this.shippingAddress.trim()) { alert('Please enter your shipping address'); return; } this.isLoading = true; const buyerName = localStorage.getItem('username'); if (!buyerName) { alert('Please login first'); this.router.navigate(['/login']); return; } // Save shipping address localStorage.setItem('shippingAddress', this.shippingAddress); // Create orders const orders = this.orderData.items.map((item: any) => ({ itemName: item.name, buyer: buyerName, price: Number(item.price), quantity: Number(item.quantity), delivered: false, orderStatus: 'PENDING', orderDate: new Date().toISOString(), shippingAddress: this.shippingAddress, paymentMethod: this.selectedPaymentMethod, })); let completedOrders = 0; let hasError = false; orders.forEach((order: any) => { this.salesService.createOrder(order).subscribe({ next: (response: any) => { completedOrders++; this.orderId = response.id; if (completedOrders === orders.length && !hasError) { this.isLoading = false; this.paymentSuccess = true; // Clear cart localStorage.removeItem('checkout_cart'); localStorage.removeItem('cart'); // Redirect after 2 seconds setTimeout(() => { this.router.navigate(['/orders']); }, 2000); } }, error: (err: any) => { console.error('Error placing order:', err); hasError = true; this.isLoading = false; alert('Failed to place order. Please try again.'); }, }); }); } goBackToCart(): void { this.router.navigate(['/cart']); } goToOrders(): void { this.router.navigate(['/orders']); } formatPrice(price: number): string { if (!price) return '0'; return price.toLocaleString('en-IN'); } }
